course_info.trial_description:
Fun Grammar Lessons for young learners and Grammar Practice for adults

My Grammar Practice for adults worksheets are filled with useful, everyday language that will boost your grammar skills and help you develop your fluency. Each lesson includes a variety of reading, writing and speaking tasks activities on a particular grammar target. These lessons are a lifeline for any student looking for extra ways to reinforce a specific grammar point.

Fun Grammar Lessons teach young learners the building blocks of English with kid-friendly lessons that are full of pictures and fun activities. Each lesson includes simple grammar notes and exercises that will help introduce and develop core grammar skills required for fluency. 

I also have Grammar Assessment Tests to determine your current English level. 

Grammar Test 1-Beg: a low or mid-range score indicates that students should use our beginner-level materials. A high score indicates that they can use low-intermediate or intermediate materials. 

Grammar Test 2-Low Int: a low or mid-range score indicates that students should use our beginner or low-intermediate materials. A high score indicates that they can use intermediate materials. 

Grammar Test 3 – Int: it is recommended that students get a high grade on Grammar Tests 1 and 2 before trying Test 3. For placement, a low or mid-range score on Grammar Test 3 indicates that students should use our intermediate-level materials. A high score indicates that they may be ready for high-intermediate or advanced materials. 

Grammar Test 4 - High Int – Adv: it is also recommended that students get a high grade on Grammar Tests 1, 2, and 3 before trying Test 4. For placement, a low or mid-range score on Grammar Test 4 indicates that students should use our intermediate – high-intermediate materials. A high score indicates that they can use advanced materials as well as authentic reading and listening materials.

"Hello! Where's the Lake Town?" Bray asked an 81-year-old
tending some cows. She gave him a puzzled look. "Gee, nobody 
here speaks English," he thought. 

And although Bray had studied the local language at school for
nine years, he had pretty much forgotten everything.

So he kept pedaling along, trying to figure out how to get to the
town, and his accommodation. It was getting dark.

Suddenly, a teenager came into view; he was gathering raspberries, 
cranberries, gooseberries. To Bray's relief — and astonishment — 
the teen was able to give him directions. In perfect English.

“How did you master English?” Bray asked him. 
“Oh, from watching cartoons on TV when I was young,” he answered.

Grammar: Practice grammar structures and focus on the areas that are problematic for you and you’ll be given practice exercises and tools that help you grasp grammar concepts.

Speaking: Talk about your favorite topics and hobbies all the while focusing on your pronunciation, intonation, and word stress. Many English learners have a wide vocabulary but sadly aren’t understood because they lack understanding of word stress and intonation. 

Listening: Perhaps you can read and speak English well, but you struggle listening to a conversation. You’ll practice by listening to interesting short audio and video clips and then we will discuss the content. 

Writing: Whether you’re writing an email or an essay, I’ll help you develop your writing skills and focus on content, style, and punctuation. 

Vocabulary: Learning new words is essential as a language learner. In every lesson, you will be exposed to new words and discuss their meaning, range, and pronunciation.

teacher_info.about_teacher: My first experience as a teacher was in my martial arts club in Pittsburgh.  I taught for 10 years.  Though this seems quite different from teaching a language, it was, in fact, excellent preparation for my career as an English teacher.  Learning correct pronunciation involves learning unfamiliar movements.  It is much more a physical skill than an academic exercise.  To achieve fluency in speaking, one cannot carefully think about each word or phrase --- words and phrases must be automatic.  To learn to speak automatically, one must practice regularly and diligently.  I prefer to correct a student's mistakes immediately so that s/he is more likely to remember the correct usage.
teacher_info.teaching_style: In my experience, many students were never taught the basic sounds of English.  For this reason, I always include phonics exercises as part of every class.  When teaching grammar, I focus on the meaning of a particular construction rather than just how to make it.  It is important for students to do exercises that require them to choose between more than one possible grammatical construction.  This replicates real life, where one must choose the construction that will communicate the correct meaning.

Remaining silent for fear of making mistakes hurts you more in the end. Mistakes are opportunities to learn, so don't let insecurity keep you from communicating! Why is it easier for us to repeat song lyrics in another language than to remember the verb tenses (past, present, future)? You might say that the first is entertaining while the second is serious. Well, I happen to believe that learning a new language can be just as fun. I customize topics based on what you are interested in: nature, music, sports, food, etc. I also challenge my students to incorporate English into their daily life through movies, social media, games, books, etc. Sound fun? pro_course_detail.title: Speak with Confidence: 7 Packages to Choose From!
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you confident while speaking in English? Do you want to expand your vocabulary? 
Are you worried about your pronunciation? If you answered "yes" to any of these questions, then these lessons are for you!

These Speak with Confidence packages focus on applying the grammar and vocabulary that you already know to real world topics that you're already interested in. 

There are 7 packages to choose from which range from 6-8 lessons in each. Lessons are designed for students levels B1-C2. 

1) Science & Technology (science, technology, engineering, and math)
2) Fun & Entertainment (movies, music, sports, books, etc.)
3) Food & Travel (flights/accommodations, food/shopping, etc.)
4) People & Planet (culture, history, nature, etc.)
5) Love & Relationships (communication, personal boundaries, etc.)
6) Health & Wellness (physical, emotional, spiritual, etc.)
7) Finance & Investments (budgets, savings, investing, etc.)

Are you ready to face the world with confidence? You will be after these lessons. 

Let's get started!

pro_course_detail.title: Write with Confidence: Send Me Your Writing Draft!
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need someone to look over what you have already written, brainstorm an assignment for school, or help you express yourself through written words? 

Well, from blogs and essays to short stories and letters, we can explore it all! And along the way, I will give you feedback on your grammar, punctuation, and vocabulary use.  

I encourage you to bring in drafts of your work, so that we can maximize our time together. However, no preparation is required. 

Are you a busy professional and don't have time to meet? Sign up for a 30-minute lesson and send me a draft of your work ahead of time. I will use that time to edit and send back comments. No attendance necessary. 

Watch your confidence grow with every sentence.

Let's get started!

pro_course_detail.title: English Your Way: Unplanned Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you just want someone to talk with? Someone who can also give you feedback on your grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary mistakes? 

Well, this lesson -- designed for students B1-C2 -- is an open, unstructured, and free-flowing conversation in which YOU – the student – take the lead. 

You're encouraged to share articles, video clips, and questions to start the conversation. However, no preparation is required. Just bring your curiosity. 

We can talk about almost any topic: culture, travel, relationships, finances, technology, current events, and more! 

What do YOU want to talk about?

pro_course_detail.title: NEW! Group Lessons: Split Cost With Family and Friends!
pro_course_detail.description:
This option is perfect for family members and friends (up to 3 students) that want to learn together at a more affordable price. All it takes is 2 easy steps! 

1) Choose from any of the Speak with Confidence topics: 

- Science & Technology (science, technology, engineering, and math)
- Fun & Entertainment (movies, music, sports, books, etc.)
- Food & Travel (flights, accommodations, food, shopping, etc.)
- People & Planet (culture, history, philosophy, and nature)
- Love & Relationships (love languages, personal boundaries, etc.)
- Health & Wellness (physical, emotional, spiritual, etc.)
- Finance & Investments (budgets, savings, investing, etc.)

2) Choose a time that works best for everyone and I will create a lesson that is unlike anything you could experience alone. 

Don't miss out on this unique learning opportunity while making memories with family and friends. 

Let's get started!

pro_course_detail.title: NEW! Teacher Mentor: For Teachers of All Languages
pro_course_detail.description:
Every doctor needs a doctor, so why shouldn't teachers also have a teacher? 

As your mentor, I will assist you in creating interactive lesson plans, overcoming any challenges you may come across, and taking your teaching to the next level. 

No matter what language you teach, I will be here to motivate, support, and guide you through your journey as a teacher.

At the end of each session, you will feel more confident, competent, and connected to the language teacher you've always wanted to be. 

Let's get started!
